# Patrick Sang — Full Site Reference

## Homepage
Canonical URL: https://patrick-sang.is-a.dev/
Title/position: Patrick Sang — Geospatial Software Developer.
Purpose: Portfolio presenting geospatial development services, data solutions, projects, tools, workflow, and contact details.

### Professional overview
The homepage describes work designing systems for spatial datasets, developing analytical models, building interactive dashboards and maps, automating spatial workflows, and deploying mapping services to support data-informed decisions.

### Services

#### Geospatial data management and automation
Spatial data creation, processing, governance, integration, validation, quality assurance, and workflow automation.

#### Geospatial analysis and visualization
Spatial statistics, hotspot and pattern analysis, predictive spatial modelling, network and proximity analysis, and interactive visualization.

#### Remote sensing and Earth observation
Satellite imagery analysis and monitoring of land use, land cover, agriculture, and environmental change.

#### Web GIS and application development
Interactive web maps, location-based applications, web GIS platforms, and geoportal integrations.

#### Cartography and map production
Interactive maps, digital map files, print-ready maps, atlases, and map collections.

#### GIS capacity building
Training and support in GIS and remote-sensing methods for practical problem solving.

### Spatial analysis capabilities
- Spatial statistics, spatial autocorrelation, hotspot analysis, and spatial regression.
- Pattern and trend detection, cluster analysis, and spatiotemporal analysis.
- Predictive spatial modelling, risk assessment, and suitability scoring.
- Network, proximity, overlay, terrain, and spatial relationship analysis.
- Interactive web maps, data visualization, cartography, and map books.

### Data lifecycle capabilities
- Data creation, digitization, cleaning, and processing.
- Data governance, lineage, metadata, and quality assurance.
- Spatial data integration, APIs, data distribution, and access management.
- GIS workflow automation and custom scripting.

### Technology stack displayed on the homepage

#### Databases and spatial platforms
PostgreSQL, PostGIS, DuckDB (Spatial and H3 extensions), AWS RDS, Amazon Athena.

#### Programming
Python, R, SQL, JavaScript, Node.js, Shell scripting.

#### GIS and mapping
QGIS, MapLibre GL JS, Leaflet, Folium, Kepler.gl, deck.gl, Overture Maps.

#### Dashboards and BI
Dash, FastAPI, Power BI, Looker Studio, Shiny, HTML reports.

#### GeoAI and modelling
scikit-learn, XGBoost, PySAL, TensorFlow, Suitability scoring, LISA.

#### Spatial data formats
GeoPackage, GeoParquet, Shapefile, CSV, H3, GeoJSON, JSON routing outputs.

#### Remote sensing
Sentinel-2, MODIS, Landsat, UAV/drone data, NDVI and spectral indices, Google Earth Engine.

#### Data engineering
Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Spark/Sedona, Docker, Git, ETL/ELT pipelines.

#### Routing
Jsprit, GraphHopper, OpenStreetMap, Vehicle routing, Multi-depot optimization.

#### Intelligence and automation
Claude API, Computer vision, n8n, LLMs.

### Project delivery process
1. Scoping: clarify objectives, deliverables, timelines, budget, data sources, and constraints.
2. Solution design: select an appropriate architecture, methods, and technologies.
3. Data gathering and preparation: acquire, clean, transform, validate, and organize data.
4. Execution: deliver maps, applications, dashboards, reports, databases, portals, or mobile-ready solutions.

### Industry use cases
Business, insurance, healthcare, banking, real estate, sales and marketing, agriculture, retail, utilities and asset management, logistics, and monitoring and evaluation.
